question: Apple's Products gross margin dollars increased in FY2025 ($112,887M vs $109,633M in FY2024) but Products gross margin percentage decreased (36.8% vs 37.2%). What explains this?
answer: Products gross margin rose to $112,887 million in FY2025 from $109,633 million in FY2024, reflecting favorable costs and a different product mix (partially offset by tariff costs) [2][1]. At the same time, the margin percentage fell to 36.8% from 37.2% because the mix shift and tariff costs reduced the overall margin rate, though other favorable costs provided some offset [2][1].
